title: Q-GAP-capability-evidence-precision: Competitor capabilities are evidenced by a sentence of the page body, not by a navigation word
body:
**Owner:** reviewer
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'grep:foundation/rnd.py::def body_text'
**Prediction:** market_open_gaps <= 5 within 720 h
**Status:** open

Gap in component `verification`: Competitor capabilities are evidenced by a sentence of the page body, not by a navigation word. The R&D taxonomy matches one regular expression per capability over the whole page text, so a menu entry such as "Azure DevOps" or "Pull requests" counts as evidence of other-cloud or autonomous-pr; 2026-11-26 profiles show both. Source: doctrine/market.json (MARKET-1). The proof is `grep:foundation/rnd.py::def body_text`, shipped with a test.

**Out of scope:** any other gap in the register, and a proof file with no behaviour and no test behind it.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'grep:foundation/rnd.py::def body_text'
